newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline touch firmer, waits for NYMEX.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline touch firmer, waits for NYMEX.

text.p: NWE gasoline was $1 or so stronger on Friday as U.S. demand continued to drive the energy complex and keep prices firm.

Dealers said eurograde barges traded in ARA at $191 and $193 with local supply becoming a touch tightish. The market was looking at arbitraging to the United States in order to take advantage of take prices over there.
The market was seen to have room to move higher if NYMEX kicked in with strong numbers later in the afternoon, traders said.
Regular grade material was also looking limited on the supply side and $183.00 was heard offered.
August swaps were seen around $193.25 with September $2.50 backwardated and October a further $2 or so lower.
